name: NVX Session
_comment_key: Pins the extension id. Without it Chromium derives the id from the absolute path of the unpacked folder, so moving or renaming the folder produces a different extension: new id, empty storage, every session gone. With it the id is this key, wherever the build sits, and a rebuild is an update rather than a new install.
description: Many accounts on one site, in one window, with independent sessions per tab.
_comment_commands: Chrome allows at most four commands to suggest a key, and open-panel uses one, so sessions 1 to 3 get Alt+1 to Alt+3 out of the box and 4 to 8 are declared but unbound, ready for the user to assign at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. The handler moves the active tab to the Nth session in the list.
